To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the social capital theory provides valuable insights into the informal learning process, that the wiki environment provides an effective means to enhance informal learning, that the informal learning process can be divided into three distinct types of participants, namely leaders, collaborative editors and lone editors, and that leaders and collaborative editors are more likely to engage in informal learning.

(i) social capital theory can be used to understand how people decide to take part and contribute in an informal learning activity; (ii) there are three distinct types of participants in these informal learning activities; (iii) these participants have different characteristics and contribute differently to the knowledge creation process.
social capital theory and social network analysis can be used to provide insights into how people participate in informal learning activities.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of social capital in (in)forming informal learning.
the question whether a formal wiki event can contribute to the formation a network of practice and thus to informal learning.
how social capital can be used to understand and enhance informal learning activities.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a wiki event does contribute to the formation, maintenance or strengthening of a network of practices.
social capital theory is a useful lens to understand informal learning.
the formal wiki event does contribute to the formation and maintenance of a network of practices.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the wiki event is a good way to create a network of practice.
social capital can be an important factor in understanding how people decide to engage into informal learning activities.
the wiki event contributes to the formation of social capital.
The main takeaway from our work is that
social capital theory and social network analysis provide valuable insights into the informal learning of individuals.
the design of informal learning activities needs to take into account that participants will have different motivations and expectations.
the formation of a strong network is not necessary for a learning activity to be successful.
